items.title: CoEvolve: Self-Evolving Code Policies from Skills to Strategies for Humanoid Robots

items.title: Hippo: Training-Free Agent Self-Evolution via Hippocampal Replay

facts.retention: Selected experiences persist and are injected as hints through a fixed retrieval/injection procedure.
limits: No observed revision of tool implementations, the management mechanism, or a separately executable reusable skill artifact.
